title: Describing several things: plural adjective
focus: When describing ordinary plural items individually after ovat (“are”), use a plural partitive adjective: Autot ovat uusia. — The cars are new.

exercises.prompt: Describe each item individually: complete “The cars are new.” Autot ovat ____.
exercises.explanation: When describing the individual members of an ordinary plural group after ovat (“are”), use a plural partitive adjective. The subject noun remains plural nominative, the form naming the things. Keep dictionary-form uusi and add -a: uusia.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Describing several things: plural adjective: case or number confused
